snippet.title: Totally unbiased review of my own FPV Sim (The Zone)
snippet.description:
This is a summary of all the drones, maps and features in my new FPV simulator: The Zone.
I tried my best to show the "raw" experience and not cherry pick only the best parts, but I probably still did 🤓

Discord: https://discord.gg/jhAK4UesUF
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3491280/The_Zone__FPV_Drone_Simulator/

0:00 - Intro
1:45 - Main menu and settings
2:05 - Configure ARM and Turtle mode switch
2:39 - Drones and Physics settings
3:00 - Rates
3:22 - 5" Freestyle physics
5:14 - 3.5" Physics
5:41 - 85mm Whoop
6:24 - 65mm Whoop
7:07 - Wing?
7:19 - Maps
 7:25 - Map 2: Triangle bando
8:33 - Map 3: Ikea
8:37 - Wing!
9:47 - Quads on Ikea
10:43 - Custom map 1
12:25 - Custom map 2
13:47 - Signal simulation: Analog
15:17 - Signal simulation: Digital
17:02 - Racing mode
17:52 - Practice mode / ACRO Trainer
19:45 - Multiplayer
20:28 - Trails
21:03 - Yes the graphics are ass
21:30 - Maps a bit buggy and unpolished
21:58 - Join discord for questions and requests
22:17 - Custom maps with Blender
